dispositionDefinitions.review-as-is: The normalized draft is structurally atomic, but still requires exact-source human review.
dispositionDefinitions.split-before-review: The normalized draft contains multiple propositions and must be split before any standing decision.
dispositionDefinitions.rewrite-before-review: The normalized language contains interpretation or overreach and must be bounded before any standing decision.
